integrity.proof_type: classical analytic number theory and independent prime cylinders

limitations: Only an iterated natural-density-then-threshold limit is proved; no joint uniform error in both parameters.
No general positive-threshold closed CDF and no upper-tail asymptotic is claimed.
Possible unindexed equivalent or more general small-deviation theorem remains a priority risk.
scientific_scope: Distribution of w(n)/n under natural density, with density limit preceding the lower-threshold limit.
title: Mertens lower-tail law for Erdős's prime-power quotient sum
